title: Add, read and remove parameters on a schematic wire
summary: Adds a parameter as a child object of a schematic wire, lists and removes the wire's parameters, and shows schematic right-click menu items whose GetState makes them visible only over a wire.
phrasings: attach a parameter to a wire
list parameters on a schematic wire
show a right-click menu item only over a wire
find the object under the right-click position

commands.name: AddParameterToWire
commands.description: Add a parameter to the wire under the right-click cursor or the selected wire
commands.params: Name=<text, default NewParamName>|Value=<text, default NewParamValue>|Wire=popup|selected (default selected)|Index=<n, 0-based among the selected wires, default 0>

commands.name: GetParameterFromWire
commands.description: List the parameters of the wire under the right-click cursor or the selected wire

commands.name: RemoveParameterFromWire
commands.description: Remove the parameters of the wire under the right-click cursor or the selected wire
commands.params: Name=<text, optional: remove only parameters with this name; default all>|Wire=popup|selected (default selected)|Index=<n, default 0>

commands.name: ListWires
commands.description: List the wires of the current sheet with their parameter counts (test helper)

commands.name: SelectWire
commands.description: Select one wire of the current sheet by its ListWires index (test helper; changes the selection only)
